lessons.title: Propositional Logic — Statements, Connectives, and Truth Tables
math: Truth-table size for n variables: 2^n rows.

lessons.title: Applications of Propositional Logic — Translation, Specifications, and Puzzles
math: Consistent(S₁,…,Sₙ) ⇔ ∃ assignment ν such that ν(Sᵢ) = T for every i.
Tautology ⇔ all rows T. Contradiction ⇔ all rows F. Contingency ⇔ at least one of each.

lessons.title: Propositional Equivalences — Laws of Logic and Symbolic Manipulation
math: P ≡ Q  ⇔  ⊨ P ↔ Q  (P ↔ Q is a tautology).

lessons.title: Predicates and Quantifiers — From Statements to Universes
math: On finite U = {a₁,…,aₙ}: ∀x P(x) ≡ ⋀ᵢ P(aᵢ); ∃x P(x) ≡ ⋁ᵢ P(aᵢ).
Empty domain: ∀x P(x) = T (vacuous), ∃x P(x) = F.

lessons.title: Nested Quantifiers — Order Matters
math: ∃y ∀x P(x,y) ⇒ ∀x ∃y P(x,y); not generally the reverse.
Limit definition: ∀ε>0 ∃δ>0 ∀x (|x − a| < δ → |f(x) − L| < ε) — pure ∀∃∀.

lessons.title: Rules of Inference — Building Valid Arguments
math: Hypothetical Syllogism: [p → q, q → r] ⊢ p → r.
UI: ∀x P(x) ⊢ P(c). UG: P(c) arbitrary ⊢ ∀x P(x).
EI: ∃x P(x) ⊢ P(c) for fresh c. EG: P(c) ⊢ ∃x P(x).

lessons.title: Introduction to Proofs — Direct, Contrapositive, and Contradiction
math: Contradiction: to prove p, assume ¬p, derive r ∧ ¬r.
Vacuous: ¬p ⇒ p → q. Trivial: q ⇒ p → q.
n even ⇔ ∃k ∈ ℤ : n = 2k. n odd ⇔ ∃k ∈ ℤ : n = 2k + 1.

lessons.title: Proof Methods and Strategy — Cases, Existence, Counterexamples, Uniqueness
math: Cases: (p₁ ∨ ⋯ ∨ pₙ) → q proved as (p₁ → q) ∧ ⋯ ∧ (pₙ → q).
WLOG ⇔ symmetric cases collapse to one labeled subproof.
Counterexample for ∀x P(x): a single c with ¬P(c).
Forward + backward reasoning: at each step ask 'what do I know now?' (forward) and 'what would suffice?' (backward).
